title: Fanuc Oi-Mate Parameter Backup to CompactFlash Procedure
supports: Boot-menu SRAM/parameter backup to a CompactFlash card is described as virtually identical across Fanuc 0i, 16i, 18i and 21i controls (via search snippet; non-OEM source)

title: Fanuc RJ-3 File 001 Device Not Ready PCMCIA Backup Fix
supports: Dedicated CF-to-PCMCIA adapters work on RJ-3, 0i-MC and 16i/18i/21i memory-card interfaces; 5V-only cards may not (via search snippet; non-OEM source)

title: Everspin MR4A16B datasheet (third-party mirror)
supports: MR4A16B absolute maximum magnetic field during write Hmax_write = 8000 A/m; device has magnetic protection but fields above max rating must be avoided (via search snippet)

title: Everspin MRAM magnetic field immunity application note
supports: Write-cycle field immunity: 2,000 A/m for parallel parts up to 4Mb, 8,000 A/m for 16Mb parallel, 12,000 A/m for serial MRAM (via search snippet)

title: Kernel Samepage Merging (KSM)
supports: KSM is enabled by default in Proxmox VE; the wiki suggests disabling it for hosting services for security reasons (via search snippet)

title: Enable KSM (forum thread)
supports: ksmtuned enabled by default and starts merging when host memory use reaches ~80% (KSM_THRES_COEF=20) (via search snippet)

title: FA-A-0184: Discontinuation of MELSEC-Q ATA card Q2MEM-8MBA
supports: Q2MEM-8MBA ATA card discontinued; replace with SRAM card, or SD memory card when a High-speed Universal model QCPU is used (via search snippet)

title: Memtest86+ ECC memory support (discussion #248)
supports: Reporting of ECC-corrected memory errors is not currently supported in memtest86+; EDAC support is an open request (via search snippet)

title: Memtest86+ Version 7 Fresh For 2024
supports: Memtest86+ v7 adds only preliminary ECC support for AMD Zen; no Intel Xeon Scalable ECC reporting named (via search snippet)

title: wafer.space GF180MCU Run 1
supports: wafer.space runs are produced by Singapore-based wafer.space on GF 180nm MCU; the page does not name a U.S. fab (via search snippet)
